scope: All22 TypeScript SDK src/*.ts files, manual full-text runtime review; no claim of exhaustive proof or Python feature parity
source_state: Shared authorized uncommitted hardening; per-path digests bind exact reviewed snapshots. Later source edits require refresh.
methods_limit: Source semantic review plus focused regression evidence; not live paid API execution, kernel crash fault injection, or independent end-to-end completeness certification.

validation.full_final_typescript_gate: parent coordinates after all owners freeze
validation.spool_fixture_limit: Spool regression uses noncanonical legacy role tool_result/source sdk; tests isolate durable byte/recovery behavior and do not establish descriptor schema validity. Separate actual-emission contract regressions belong to qualification owner.
validation.test_isolation: PII boundary tests reset module warning cache before each case; all timing, scan-boundary and detection assertions preserved, raw-value absence assertions added. Three privacy tests still prove shape dedup and quiet behavior.

findings.evidence: test/id-diagnostic-privacy.test.ts; no raw values in SDK ID warnings/placeholder diagnostics, bounded128 shape cache.
test/propagation.test.ts; predecode256 value bound,32members,16448totalchars; malformed runtime type refusal.
test/spool-recovery-regression.test.ts: failed reconciliation retains bytes; next writer independently read back exact object bytes and stored manifest after retry.
Same test independently parses/checksums complete short-write spool; zero-progress publishes no record and reports dropped.
Closed v1 coverage nesting and descriptor-status observed roles corrected; qualification owner reports80 native +4 actual-schema cross-language tests. Final full gate coordinated by parent.

decision.ts removes noncanonical memory direction and side_effect_id descriptor binding keys; role/event metadata preserves semantics. Qualification owner actual-emission schema regressions cover these paths.
content.ts refuses zero-item serialization; ContentSink uri/close return undefined without submission/stamp; Decision getter docs agree. Absence is not complete capture.

crash_behavior_limit: Spool temp bytes fsynced before rename and directory fsync; failed writes clean temp, no pending success on partial writes. Failed recovered reconciliation preserves original record for restart. Real power-loss/kernel crash not exercised; leftover temps after abrupt kill may remain and unkeyed spool requires trusted storage.

files.inspected_scope: All constants and reserved-prefix guards; compared public recorder export surface.
files.findings_and_limits: Reserved namespaces blocked at convenience entrypoints; explicit setAttribute escape hatch and caller metadata remain trusted.

files.inspected_scope: All capture, operation sequence, descriptor, store/policy branches and state exposure.
files.findings_and_limits: Explicit byte evidence only; mutable caller-visible objects and caller-supplied identity do not establish independent witness or Python reconstruction parity.

files.inspected_scope: All LLM/tool construction, usage, retries, raw versus governed content and terminal callbacks.
files.findings_and_limits: Raw captureContent opt-in can emit content directly; counters/retry metadata are supplied observations, not proof of physical attempts.

files.inspected_scope: All environment/default merging, identity checks, content setup, execution/decision creation and shutdown.
files.findings_and_limits: close discards writer FlushResult; callers need flushContent/status readback for pending/failure visibility. Host OTel configuration remains responsible for exports.

files.inspected_scope: All role filtering, serialization, bounded truncation, descriptor creation, subscriber and manifest settlement. Final empty-window URI and close branches reviewed.
files.findings_and_limits: Legacy payload path stores plaintext; raw error reasons can reach local manifest. Protection is not automatic across arbitrary host attributes. Zero observed items now yield no URI, manifest submission or reference stamp; this absence is not capture completeness.

files.inspected_scope: All local path/link guards, atomic writes, descriptors/manifests, byte evidence and S3 operations; reread current short-write diff.
files.findings_and_limits: Checked writes fix partial publication; Node path checks require trusted ancestors/no concurrent adversarial namespace mutation. S3 IAM and peer authentication external; exists collapses errors to false.

files.inspected_scope: All config limits, task lifecycle, spool checksum/recovery/quarantine, retry, reconciliation and flush; authored/reviewed bounded durability fixes.
files.findings_and_limits: Retains recovered record when reconciliation fails; short-write loop rejects invalid progress. Spool is plaintext/base64 with unkeyed checksum, trusted local ownership required. Cleanup errors may permit safe duplicate delivery; not a durable receipt proof.

files.inspected_scope: All canonical bytes, descriptor/truncation, manifest roles/completeness; reviewed coverage patch against existing v1 contract. Final empty-accumulator serialization refusal reviewed.
files.findings_and_limits: Coverage nesting/descriptor-status observed roles corrected by qualification owner. JS canonical number representation not universal Python byte parity; validation of arbitrary caller bindings remains external. Empty accumulator now refuses serialization rather than emitting a schema-invalid or apparently complete transcript.

files.inspected_scope: All tags/baseline/signature normalization and attribute application.
files.findings_and_limits: Signature verified and baseline results are host assertions, no cryptographic verification occurs here; free vocabulary/key identifiers require host privacy policy.

files.inspected_scope: Entire implementation: callback lifecycle/ALS ownership, LLM/tool, retrieval/memory/side effect, delegation/interaction/file, capture-health and error handling. Final canonical-binding removal and empty-window URI getter documentation reviewed.
files.findings_and_limits: Local callback completion excludes detached producers. Side-effect committed is caller-reported; retrieval does not prove consumed context; erase marker performs no deletion. Legacy memory direction/side_effect_id extra descriptor bindings removed to satisfy closed v1 contract; direction remains in role/event semantics and side-effect identity in event metadata.

files.inspected_scope: All schema/enum/role limits, policy snapshots, protection modes/redactor paths and output.
files.findings_and_limits: Modes and missing-redactor handling prevent default raw fallback in this API; standalone policy does not force legacy content sink or arbitrary OTel paths through it.

files.inspected_scope: Entire lifecycle, active context, retry identity and closed exception classification.
files.findings_and_limits: Completed denotes callback return, not causal closure of detached work or remote commit. Caller retry metadata remains observational.

files.inspected_scope: All SHA helpers, Python-compatible string/float formatting, recursive canonical object serialization and rejection branches.
files.findings_and_limits: Cycles/deep inputs can throw; hashes not authentication; Python whole-valued floats are explicitly outside byte-exact JS contract.

files.inspected_scope: All required/optional ID checks, placeholder and PII-shape handling; authored bounded diagnostics/cache and regression. Internal non-barrel-exported warning reset helper reviewed for parity test isolation; production dedup unchanged.
files.findings_and_limits: Automatic diagnostics now field+shape only, bounded and deduplicated; ID warnings do not sanitize identifiers or free-form metadata.

files.inspected_scope: Every exported symbol and namespace reviewed against imported implementation and recorder scope.
files.findings_and_limits: Public exports include legacy content and optional policy APIs; exports do not establish fully integrated governed encrypted reconstruction.

files.inspected_scope: All carrier/key parsing, trace context and encode/decode/inject/extract; authored predecode size/member/type guards.
files.findings_and_limits: Inbound header/value/member work is bounded and malformed types refused. Correlation context is unauthenticated metadata, never tenant authorization.

files.inspected_scope: All explicit attribute exports compared with attributes.ts definitions.
files.findings_and_limits: Closed public vocabulary is not an exporter/privacy allowlist; host can emit arbitrary custom OTel attributes.

files.inspected_scope: All legacy object/manifest lookup, store ownership, length/digest/representation checks and transcript export statuses.
files.findings_and_limits: Legacy ContentResolver does not provide Python governed capability/encryption/journal resolver parity. Read errors/statuses are explicit, but some error strings are local caller-visible.

files.inspected_scope: All testing namespace exports.
files.findings_and_limits: Exposes warning/coverage reset helpers only; no production verification proof.

files.inspected_scope: All tracer/provider setup, optional imports and error reporting.
files.findings_and_limits: Provider/exporter belongs to host; SDK configuration alone does not authenticate destination or prove collector receipt.

files.inspected_scope: Every scalar/finite/integer/length/enum/type guard and error renderer.
files.findings_and_limits: Throws for malformed caller programming input; describe(string) includes invalid caller string in thrown errors. No automatic telemetry export path found after protected callback exception handling; caller error logging must apply privacy policy.

files.inspected_scope: Entire SDK and GenAI schema identity constants compared with package metadata.
files.findings_and_limits: Static instrumentation identity, not artifact authenticity or release qualification.

codeql_context.disposition: Filesystem check/use races remain open as expected; reviewed source requires trusted customer-owned namespace. No alert dismissal or suppression.
